caption: The drawing displays a single wooden chair with armrests and a high back. The wood appears to be a medium brown color, with visible grain and turned spindle detailing on the legs, arm supports, and back posts. The back of the chair features three horizontal slats, each with a slightly curved upper edge, and the top corners of the back posts are capped with simple finials. The seat is covered with a cushion that is deep red or maroon in color and appears slightly textured or worn. The chair is positioned against a plain, light beige background that contains some minor discoloration and faint marks but no other objects or elements. The drawing presents the chair in a three-quarter view, clearly showing both the front and one side.
title: Arm Chair
